FR-001.title: First-run setup must require selecting the organisation currency (ISO 4217); default AUD

FR-002.title: Selected currency is fixed for the dataset lifetime; no change, no multi-currency, no FX

FR-003.title: All money display/print/export uses the configured currency symbol and minor-unit precision, grouping per region

FR-004.title: No screen/report/PDF/CSV may show a currency symbol or code other than the configured one

FR-005.title: Apportioned amounts round to the currency minor unit and the parts re-sum to the total exactly

FR-006.title: Existing AUD datasets show identical symbol, precision and stored values after the change

FR-007.title: Entering an amount stores the exact intended value regardless of regional number format

FR-008.title: Manual journal and opening-balance entry interpret typed amounts like every other money field

FR-009.title: Comma-decimal / period-grouping regions must not scale or misread an entered amount

FR-010.title: Balance Sheet generation verifies assets equal liabilities plus equity or refuses a clean statement

FR-011.title: Trial Balance treats any non-zero debit/credit difference as an error, with no tolerance

FR-012.title: Each financial statement states its basis of accounting accurately on its face

FR-013.title: Bank reconciliation report uses the conventional adjusted-balance form showing both balances

FR-014.title: Outstanding items are carried into the reconciliation arithmetic, not just listed

FR-015.title: Finalising a reconciliation still requires it to balance; finalised recs stay immutable

FR-016.title: Organisation can mark all financial periods up to a chosen date as closed

FR-017.title: Any transaction dated on/before the closed-through date is rejected with no partial record

FR-018.title: Setup-time opening balances remain permitted regardless of a later closed-through date

FR-019.title: Financial-year start is an explicit first-run setup choice, not a silent default

FR-020.title: System supports a financial year starting on a day other than the first of the month

FR-021.title: All FY-preset reports and dashboard figures honour the configured FY start (month and day)

FR-022.title: System should support a sub-twelve-month first financial year, labelled as a part-year

FR-023.title: Default audit-trail retention on a new dataset is at least five years, still configurable

FR-024.title: An existing dataset's configured retention value is preserved through this change

FR-025.title: A failed purge of expired audit entries is logged and surfaced, never silently discarded

FR-026.title: Every financial posting path, incl. attendance-fee accruals, writes an audit-trail entry

FR-027.title: Publish an accounting-policy document (basis, recognition, rounding, currency, immutability, retention, unaudited)

FR-028.title: Finance living spec updated to the current tax model, no retired references, not draft

FR-029.title: Produce a written sales-tax internationalisation assessment covering four required points

FR-030.title: Assessment records an in/out-of-scope decision with sizing per point and spawns follow-on issues

FR-031.title: No stored monetary amount, tax amount, or GL balance is altered; presentation/validation/config only

FR-032.title: Existing double-entry guarantees preserved (balanced atomic postings, GL truth, immutability, reversing corrections)

FR-033.title: No change to existing tax posting mechanics or stored tax code values

context: source: GitHub issue #341 and sub-issues #342-#352 (international accounting-practice readiness)
living spec: finance (primary), reports-pipeline, settings, domain-model, data-access, app-host, audit-trail

area: src/StageFright.Core/Modules/Finance (MoneyFormatter, TaxCalculator, FinancialYearCalculator), src/StageFright.Reports/Providers, src/StageFright.Core/Entities/Settings.cs, src/StageFright.Data/Repositories/GLRepository.cs, src/StageFright.UI setup wizard + finance forms
constraint: preserve the double-entry guarantees (balanced atomic postings, GL as sole source of truth, immutable Fee/Payment/Transaction/JournalEntry, reversing-entry corrections)
constraint: no change to any stored monetary amount, tax amount, GL balance, or existing tax posting mechanics — presentation/validation/config only
constraint: single currency per organisation; no multi-currency or FX
intent: Make the finance module's accounting practices safe and portable for organisations outside Australia (configurable ISO 4217 currency, locale-safe money entry, Balance Sheet / Trial Balance integrity guards, disclosed basis of accounting, conventional bank reconciliation, closed-period lock, first-class financial-year-start setup, longer audit retention, and a written accounting-policy document) without changing any stored amount or the double-entry engine.
expectations: Multi-currency, changing the organisation currency after setup, and foreign-exchange translation
Implementing multi-jurisdiction or multiple simultaneous sales-tax rates (only a scoping assessment is in scope)
Producing formal IFRS/GAAP statutory financial statements
Any change to existing tax posting mechanics or stored tax code values
approach: Reuse spec 027's localization seams: currency becomes a fixed-after-setup Settings.CurrencyCode (ISO 4217, default AUD) with MoneyFormatter converted from hard-coded $ to a process-wide-configured helper backed by an internal CurrencyCatalog (no new NuGet). The money-entry bug is fixed by parsing the always-invariant <input type=number> value with InvariantCulture via one shared MoneyInput helper. Statement integrity, the basis-of-accounting disclosure and the conventional bank-reconciliation layout are changes inside StageFright.Reports providers plus one optional ReportData field; period locking is enforced at the single GLRepository choke point via a new ClosedPeriodException.

decisions.decision: Convert MoneyFormatter to a process-wide configured static (Configure() at startup) rather than an injected IMoneyFormatter service
decisions.why: Single currency per dataset makes process-wide state correct; mirrors the existing startup-culture pattern in MauiProgram; ~20 call sites stay unchanged
decisions.rejected: Injecting IMoneyFormatter everywhere and refactoring the static report-provider helpers

decisions.decision: Ship ISO 4217 symbol/minor-unit metadata as an internal curated CurrencyCatalog
decisions.why: .NET has no currency-code-keyed lookup of symbol+minor-units; a curated list mirrors SupportedLanguagesCatalog and adds no dependency
decisions.rejected: Adding a money library (NodaMoney) or embedding the full ~180-entry ISO 4217 table

decisions.decision: Keep money inputs as <input type=number> and parse their value with InvariantCulture
decisions.why: A number input always serialises its value invariant regardless of page locale; parsing invariant removes the thousands-separator ambiguity FR-009 forbids and matches how Blazor @bind already handles decimals
decisions.rejected: Switching to type=text with CurrentCulture parsing, or a custom grouping-stripping parser

decisions.decision: Enforce the closed-period lock at the GLRepository.AddBalancedSetAsync/AddPairAsync choke point via an IClosedPeriodGuard
decisions.why: Every financial mutation funnels through these two methods inside the UoW transaction, so a rejection guarantees no partial record; the repo already enforces the GL-balance invariant pre-persistence
decisions.rejected: Checking in each of the 7+ posting services (fragile, a future path could bypass it) or an EF SaveChanges interceptor

decisions.decision: Balance Sheet appends an explicit out-of-balance line; Trial Balance throws with the 0.01 tolerance removed
decisions.why: FR-010 allows either outcome; the Balance Sheet balances by construction so the out-of-balance amount is the useful diagnostic, while the Trial Balance already has a throw/retry path wired through the viewer
decisions.rejected: Making the Balance Sheet also throw (hides the magnitude) or the Trial Balance render a line (diverges from tested viewer behaviour)

decisions.decision: Deliver the basis-of-accounting disclosure as one optional ReportData.BasisOfAccounting field set by financial-statement providers from a single shared localized string
decisions.why: Matches the pipeline design (one renderer-agnostic model, no provider-specific branching); one string keeps wording consistent and translatable and lets non-financial reports leave it null
decisions.rejected: A per-provider section row (repeats text, pollutes the table) or renderer-hard-coded text (renderer must not know which reports are statements)

decisions.decision: Raise the AuditRetentionYears default 1->5 with a column-default-only migration (no UpdateData)
decisions.why: FR-024 requires an existing datasets configured value to be preserved; the single Settings row already has a value, so touching only the schema default changes behaviour for new datasets only
decisions.rejected: UpdateData to set existing rows to 5, or making the field nullable with a computed default

decisions.decision: Defer FR-022 (sub-twelve-month first financial year) to a follow-on issue
decisions.why: Spec Assumptions explicitly permit this; a part-year needs its own storage and every-FY-report labelling decisions that would widen an already-large feature
decisions.rejected: Building a minimal stub-year now

decisions.decision: Surface a failed startup audit purge by recording it into the existing startup-diagnostic state, not a new mechanism
decisions.why: The Settings capability already retains startup failures (e.g. DB init) for the UI to display; FR-025 needs logged AND surfaced, and reusing that holder adds no plumbing while startup still proceeds
decisions.rejected: A dedicated purge-failure banner service, or blocking startup on purge failure

decisions.decision: Source the bank reconciliation book balance from the existing IGLRepository.GetAccountBalanceAsync(accountId, statementDate)
decisions.why: It already exists and is keyed on AccountId (not the denormalized GLAccount string), so the report inherits the aggregate-by-identity rule with no new repository method
decisions.rejected: Recomputing the ledger balance in the provider from raw transactions

decisions.decision: Route every StageFright.Reports provider FormatCurrency helper (and TaxSummary/ChartOfAccounts inline money) through the static MoneyFormatter.Format
decisions.why: FR-003/FR-004 need the configured symbol+precision on printed/exported amounts; providers previously emitted bare ToString(F2) with no symbol
decisions.rejected: Injecting an IMoneyFormatter into every provider (churns ~10 static helpers for no behavioural gain under single-currency-per-dataset)

decisions.decision: Update the ~30 pre-existing report/UI/integration money assertions to compare against MoneyFormatter.Format(<decimal>m) rather than hard-coded "$x.xx"
decisions.why: Keeps those tests correct under the configured currency and robust to the host culture grouping, matching how production formats
decisions.rejected: Hard-coding the en-AU dollar literal (brittle if the CI host culture changes)

decisions.decision: Serialise MoneyFormatter-sensitive integration tests via a DisableParallelization xUnit collection (V6, V16, V28, AudZeroDrift)
decisions.why: MoneyFormatter.Configure sets process-wide static state; a JPY config in V28 could race the AUD assertions now in V6/V16
decisions.rejected: Disabling parallelization for the whole Integration.Tests assembly

decisions.decision: MoneyInput.Parse uses NumberStyles.AllowDecimalPoint | AllowLeadingSign only (no AllowThousands, no AllowWhite)
decisions.why: an <input type=number> value is always browser-serialised invariant (period point, no grouping, optional leading -); rejecting grouped/whitespace input and falling back to 0m matches the pre-existing empty-field=0 behaviour and FR-009 (no digit read as a thousands separator)
decisions.rejected: NumberStyles.Number|Currency with InvariantCulture (would silently accept 1,234.50 and mask a malformed value)

decisions.decision: V28_LocaleSafeMoneyEntry drives the real GeneralJournalService/OpeningBalanceService feeding amounts through MoneyInput.Parse directly, rather than rendering the razor components
decisions.why: StageFright.Integration.Tests has no bUnit reference; calling MoneyInput.Parse under fr-FR/de-DE then posting through the real services over SQLite+migrations still proves known input -> exact stored ledger value end to end (US2 AC-1..AC-3)
decisions.rejected: reflectively invoking the private ParseAmount/SetAmount, or adding bUnit to Integration.Tests

decisions.decision: Balance Sheet out-of-balance line is a trailing null-heading ReportSection with one emphasized [label, MoneyFormatter.Format(difference)] row
decisions.why: ReportData has a single GrandTotal slot, so a second emphasized row must be a section; a null heading renders the row cleanly in PDF/CSV/viewer (verified). Difference = totalAssets - (totalLiabilities + totalEquity)
decisions.rejected: Adding the row inside the Equity section (distorts the equity subtotal semantics) or a new ReportData field

decisions.decision: T040 reword also drops the literal $ prefix from Reports_TrialBalance_GLImbalanceError ({Debits}/{Credits} now carry the MoneyFormatter symbol)
decisions.why: Since T024 routed the args through MoneyFormatter the template produced a doubled $$1,000.00 under AUD; dropping the literal prefix is the correct fix and is the natural place to also drop the tolerance implication
decisions.rejected: Leaving the literal $ (doubled symbol) or switching args back to bare F2

decisions.decision: CSV basis-of-accounting note is one self-labelled record in column 0 (remaining columns blank), not a separate label column
decisions.why: CsvReportExporter has no ILocalizer and T046 delivers a single key; the label lives inside the Reports_Common_BasisOfAccounting sentence ("Basis of accounting: ..."), mirroring the section-heading write pattern already in the file
decisions.rejected: Injecting ILocalizer into CsvReportExporter to emit a separate localized label column (churns the ctor + DI registration + every call site for one label)

decisions.decision: Reports_Common_BasisOfAccounting en-US value is identical to the neutral en-AU baseline
decisions.why: follows the T040 Reports_TrialBalance_GLImbalanceError precedent where a full-sentence en-US entry mirrors neutral verbatim
decisions.rejected: an Americanised recognize/recognized spelling variant (inconsistent with the established resx pattern)

decisions.decision: TaxSummaryReportProvider sets the basis line on BOTH return paths (tax-not-applicable early return and the main summary)
decisions.why: the not-applicable view is still a financial statement and T041 asserts uniform coverage across every financial report
decisions.rejected: setting it only on the main path

decisions.decision: Bank reconciliation rewritten as one ReportSection per account with the adjusted-balance row sequence: balance per bank statement -> itemised outstanding deposits -> Add: outstanding deposits (sum, Deposit column) -> itemised outstanding payments -> Less: outstanding payments (sum) -> adjusted bank balance -> balance per general ledger -> Reconciled residual
decisions.why: FR-013 needs both balances on the face; FR-014 needs the outstanding sums carried into the adjusted-balance arithmetic (adjusted = statement + deposits - payments), not merely listed; keeps the existing 4-column Date/Description/Deposit/Payment shape and label/amount-row convention
decisions.rejected: keeping the four cleared/summary sub-sections (never showed the ledger balance, proved the tie a non-standard way)

decisions.decision: Reconciled row shows MoneyFormatter.Format(adjustedBankBalance - ledgerBalance) (0.00 when tied) rather than an in-agreement phrase; Balance-per-general-ledger label carries no {Date} placeholder
decisions.why: a zero residual between the two explicitly shown balances is itself the demonstration of agreement (SC-008) and mirrors the reports prior Difference idiom; the as-at-statement-date context already lives on the section header, so a date placeholder would be redundant and harder to assert
decisions.rejected: a separate localized in agreement / out by string, and a {Date}-parameterised ledger-balance label

decisions.decision: Removed the 10 now-dead Reports_BankReconciliation keys (SubHeader*, TotalCleared*, StatementClosingBalance, OpeningBalance, ClearedMovement, Difference) from neutral/en-US/fr-FR/qps-ploc rather than leaving them
decisions.why: the provider was their only consumer (repo-wide grep) and it was fully rewritten; the orphan-key localization guard also forbids a satellite key with no neutral entry
decisions.rejected: leaving them as harmless dead entries

decisions.decision: ClosedPeriodGuard throws a plain-message ClosedPeriodException (no ILocalizer dependency)
decisions.why: matches the existing GL-layer convention — GLRepository/GLBalanceException use literal diagnostic strings; the localized Validation_ClosedPeriod_PostingRejected text is applied at the UI catch sites (T063). Also keeps the guard trivial to construct in the ~25 test files that build GLRepository directly.
decisions.rejected: Injecting ILocalizer into the guard and resolving the resource key inside it

decisions.decision: GLRepository takes a required IClosedPeriodGuard constructor param; all 57 test construction sites updated to pass a real ClosedPeriodGuard(new SettingsRepository(db))
decisions.why: keeps the codebase-wide required-constructor-injection DA style (no nullable/optional dependency, which csharp-reviewer/silent-failure-hunter would flag). The real guard provably no-ops in those tests (no Settings row or null ClosedThroughDate).
decisions.rejected: Optional nullable param defaulting to null/no-op; a second convenience constructor

decisions.decision: The guard is called once per balanced set on the earliest line date, in AddBalancedSetAsync only; AddPairAsync inherits the check by delegation
decisions.why: the contract explicitly permits "or once for the earliest line date"; a closed period covers every date <= ClosedThroughDate so the min date is sufficient. Avoids N identical Settings reads per posting and a redundant read for every pair.
decisions.rejected: EnsureOpen per line, and an explicit second call inside AddPairAsync

decisions.decision: FinancialYearCalculator.GetRange/GetPreviousRange take startDay as an OPTIONAL param (= DefaultStartDay), with a new DefaultStartDay const mirroring DefaultStartMonth
decisions.why: keeps every existing 2-arg caller (4 report providers, OpeningBalancesWizard, ~3 report-provider test files) and its behaviour byte-identical; startDay==1 reduces the (month,day) pivot back to date.Month>=startMonth
decisions.rejected: a required startDay param forcing an edit to every call site and test

decisions.decision: Added the FY-start DAY picker to GeneralSettingsTab (post-setup edit path) as well as the setup wizard
decisions.why: the FY-start MONTH was already editable there, so a setup-only day control would leave the day permanently un-fixable post-setup; T075 already provisions the SettingsResource label
decisions.rejected: setup-wizard-only day picker

decisions.decision: Phase 9 executed implementation-before-tests (calculator -> providers -> setup plumbing -> service -> UI, then integration/bUnit tests)
decisions.why: the repo PostToolUse build-on-edit hook fails the per-file dotnet build when a test references an API added later in the wave; the wave dependency map in tasks.md is unchanged
decisions.rejected: strict test-first ordering (each new test file would hard-fail the hook and block subsequent edits)

decisions.decision: Add a non-fatal warning channel (HasStartupWarning/StartupWarning/RecordWarning) to the existing IStartupDiagnosticService rather than a new service, and stop AuditTrailService.PurgeOlderThanAsync swallowing purge failures
decisions.why: FR-025 requires the failure logged AND surfaced; the swallow was the silent discard. Reusing the holder keeps MauiPrograms existing catch as the single surfacing point; a warning (vs RecordError) never routes to the blocking /startup-error page so startup still completes
decisions.rejected: A dedicated purge-failure banner service (plan Decision 8 rejects it); or leaving the service swallow and returning a result code

decisions.decision: Surface the purge-failure warning as a dismissible banner on the Dashboard page, not the shell layout or App.razor
decisions.why: Dashboard is the post-startup landing page and an explicit T083 target; lowest blast radius (only DashboardTests needs the new DI registration); dismissal is session-local and never clears the underlying diagnostic state
decisions.rejected: ShellLayout/App.razor banner (touches every page and many test contexts); GeneralSettingsTab-only (less visible at startup)
